summary: Phase 4B Client Sign-off Loop verified end-to-end. 5 unit tests + 7 API integration tests + full frontend UI (portal signoff card, approve/ask flow, close-board green pill) all pass on preview URL.

minor.issue: The upsert to client_signoffs sets (company_id, period) as the filter but does NOT persist advisor_report_id on insert. portal_home lookup then queries client_signoffs by advisor_report_id, so a *questioned* report still surfaces on the next portal_home call as status='awaiting_approval' instead of 'questioned' (functionally OK since it stays pending, but the status pill on the client card will be wrong). Fix: include advisor_report_id in the $setOnInsert (or $set) of the upsert on line ~641 of routes/client_portal.py.

In today_feed prior-month filter at cockpit.py line 492 the whitelist is ("signoff", "deadline") but the actual source string emitted by _today_items_for_company for client sign-off items is "signoff_client". Result: prior-month client_signoff items get filtered out. Today feed thus only surfaces signoff_client cards when the signoff period == current month. Not blocking current tests but violates the review-request statement 'today includes a signoff_client item when a client has approved a period'. Fix: change filter to ("signoff", "signoff_client", "deadline").

ui_bugs.issue: After submitting a valid question via 'Send back with questions', the card remains rendered in the open textarea/submit mode instead of collapsing/refreshing to a neutral or 'questioned' state. The question is persisted correctly (visible in Recently Answered), but the ask form does not reset. Minor UX polish.

action_items: Fix portal_signoff_question upsert to persist advisor_report_id so questioned-status pill renders correctly on subsequent portal_home reads.
Extend today_feed prior-month source whitelist to include 'signoff_client' so approvals/questions on the prior period still surface in the Today feed.
Reset/collapse the SignoffCard ask form after a successful question submit (better UX).
critical_code_review_comments: portal_signoff_approve: filter for delete_many uses (company_id, period) — this deletes a prior *questioned* signoff for the same period even if it was for a different advisor_report_id. Since one report exists per (cid, period) that's fine today but worth documenting.

portal_home builds pending_signoffs by looping reports and issuing N find_one queries against client_signoffs — O(N) round-trips. For a client with 12+ reports this is minor; consider a single $in query.
advisor_reports.generate uses query params (ym, basis) while other POST endpoints across the codebase mix query and body params — inconsistent API style but not blocking.
